site.name: LLM Hub

tools.name: Cost Forecaster
tools.desc: Forecast monthly LLM costs for chatbots, agents and batch jobs.

tools.name: Model prices
tools.desc: Compare prices and context windows across providers.

tools.name: Token counter
tools.desc: Count tokens and check whether your text fits a model's context window.

tools.name: PDF & web to text
tools.desc: Turn PDFs and web pages into clean, LLM-ready text.

tools.name: AI text cleaner
tools.desc: Strip Markdown, invisible characters and em dashes.

tools.name: Chunker

tools.name: Chat export

tools.name: Prompt builder
